{"decision": "push", "reason": "页面描述了一个针对线束工程师的垂直细分工具：原理图、布线、BOM/切割长度与1:1成形板同源联动，并有浏览器协作和版本化功能，属于为特定领域做的小而专业的产品，值得一看。不过受众较窄，且页面以营销语为主，具体产品细节有限，因此只是中等强度的推荐。"}

verdict.reasoning: The reason's claims are all on the page: it targets wiring harness engineers, the schematic, wiring, BOM/cut-length and 1:1 formboard views come from one live document, and it has browser collaboration and versioning. Those are concrete features. The caveats about a narrow audience and marketing-heavy copy still frame the push as a moderate one, so the reason supports the decision.
